title: Nine Miles of Walking
subtitle: 海岸与海滨 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 海岸与海滨（自然生态·海洋与地理）
meta: 主题语境：海岸与海滨（自然生态·海洋与地理）　|　核心词汇：coast　|　正文 333 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 coast 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1944 my mother was sent to walk ① coast she could not leave, and she said the walking was the whole of the lesson. The ② coast, meaning the shore and not the sea, was nine miles long and was walked by whoever came last; coast, she said, is the only thing in a country that is judged by how much has been taken out of it.

Every ③ coast in that country had the same light, and the ④ coast at the end, meaning the one the fishermen kept and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever walked properly. Coast, my grandmother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to stay behind; my mother said the patience is the part that gets everywhere.

My father meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ coast was the whole of the journey, meaning the ease it carried and not the shore. The ⑥ coast, meaning the ease and not any of that, is the only thing in a journey that everybody enjoys and nobody questions; coast, he said, is either something you walk or the only word that means both a shore and ease. She said the ease is the part they remember.

By 1959 the ⑦ coast had become a number in a report, and the report had become an argument about the light. The ⑧ coast of the whole thing, my mother wrote in April, was nine miles and eleven years of walking; coast, she said, is either the one at the end or the reason you learned to stand on a chair. He said the chair was never mentioned.

The ⑨ coast I remember is the one at the end, which was walked in 1964 and is still described as the quietest in the county. A ⑩ coast, my grandmother said in 1969, is the only thing that improves by being walked; every coast, she said, is ease that has agreed to look like a shore. She said the ease was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 海岸（指那片岸线本身，与那片海相对）
C. 固定搭配：walk a coast 走一段海岸
D. n. 海岸（指那个国家每一段）
E. n. 海岸（指末尾那一段）
F. n. 省力（抽象：它带来的那份从容）
G. n. 那份从容（抽象：那件事本身）
H. n. 权衡；整件事的分量（抽象总称）

items.q: The coast, meaning the shore and not the sea
coast was the whole of the journey
the coast had become a number in a report
The coast of the whole thing
A coast, my grandmother said in 1969

answers.why: walk a coast 意为“走一段海岸”，1944 年母亲被派去走她离不开的那段海岸。
coast 意为“海岸、海滨”，指那片岸线本身而不是那片海，长九英里，由最后来的人走。
coast 指那个国家每一段海岸，每一段都是同样的光线。
coast 指末尾那一段（渔民熟悉的那一段），是唯一有人认真走过的。
coast 意为“省力”，抽象指它带来的那份从容，父亲说 coast 就是那段旅程的全部。
coast 为抽象用法，指那份从容本身，是一段旅程里人人都享受、却没人质疑的东西。
coast 意为“海岸、海滨”，到 1959 年这段 coast 成了报告里的一个数字。
coast 意为“权衡、整件事的分量”，母亲四月写道，整件事权衡下来是九英里和十一年的行走。
coast 意为“海岸”，我记得的是末尾那一段，1964 年走过，至今仍被说成全县最安静的。
coast 为抽象总称，祖母说一段海岸是唯一会因为被认真行走而变好的东西。
